verdict.rationale: dlt ships an official MCP server whose tools cover inspecting, debugging, and managing pipelines and runs (dlt-docs-72, dlt-probe-4), and the AI Harness MCP servers let agents deploy and run pipelines on dltHub infrastructure (dlt-docs-14). Separately, the dltHub CLI and Web UI are documented for monitoring health, inspecting logs, and diagnosing failures (dlt-docs-15), and runs can be refreshed, backfilled, and observed (dlt-docs-11). Missing for 10: no explicit evidence of an agent-facing tool that re-triggers a failed run, no public REST/OpenAPI surface (dlt-probe-3), and no hands-on or independent corroboration of the agent workflow for diagnosing and re-running failures.
